feed.title: 1mb: work
feed.subtitle: Things to use, read and build with, each shipped end to end. All the hats. One head.

entry.title: shim: A Claude Code proxy that logs its edits
entry.summary: A local proxy that runs Claude Code on DeepSeek, OpenAI, OpenRouter or Ollama, logging its rewrites and measuring every request. One Go binary.

entry.title: log: Short notes on building solo
entry.summary: A blog of short notes and essays on solo software work: shipping, maintenance, dependencies. Markdown in git, one Go binary, no database.

entry.title: cleartalk: Coaching cards for hard conversations
entry.summary: Prep for hard conversations, at work or otherwise: profile someone's communication style, pick a situation, read a coaching card. Stays in the browser.

entry.title: aipolicy: A repository's AI policy, as files
entry.summary: An AI policy generator for a repository: pick a preset, set the rules for contributors, download AI_POLICY.md, AGENTS.md and more. No install, no sign-up.

entry.title: gist: App specs for AI coding assistants
entry.summary: An app spec generator for AI coding assistants: describe an app idea, answer a few questions, download a markdown spec to start from. No account.

entry.title: sift: Hacker News threads, scored by code
entry.summary: Hacker News discussions picked by a scoring script with no editor: up to 12 threads, several runs a day, one per domain. No account, no archive.

entry.title: drift: Always-on radio in six moods
entry.summary: Always-on mood radio: focus music, ambient, lo-fi, funk and more, by mood or by album, with lyrics where a track has them. No account, no cookies.

entry.title: playbook: A book on how teams ship
entry.summary: A short book of engineering principles for software teams: collaboration, design rules, code review, adoption. Five chapters, about thirty minutes.

entry.title: nivomoney: A neobank, opened up to be read
entry.summary: Neobank demo source: Go microservices, a double-entry ledger in Postgres, React apps, ADRs. Synthetic data, no real money.

entry.title: ledgerq: A message queue in a directory
entry.summary: An embedded Go message queue: a persistent, disk-backed log in a directory. No broker, one process, one read position, zero dependencies.

entry.title: markgo: A blog engine in one Go binary
entry.summary: A flat-file Go blog engine: markdown files in a directory, a web compose form, one binary with embedded assets. No database, no build step.
